title: Modal focus effect re-runs whenever onClose changes identity, stealing focus on parent re-renders
test: tests/browser/ui-semantics.spec.mjs: 'a viewer joining while the leave-host dialog is open keeps focus on the button in use' (chromium project)
proof: Before the fix (build of the unchanged src/components/Modal.jsx) the test failed at the focus assertion after the viewer joined: document.activeElement was the 'Stay Here' button where 'Leave and Stop' was expected. The viewer join re-renders HostView, which passes a fresh inline onClose to the open Modal. After the fix the test passes, and the full ui-semantics.spec.mjs passes 41 and skips 7 (mobile-only skips) on chromium and mobile-chrome. Escape still closes the dialog and focus returns to the Watch nav link.
